old: **Craft (4.1):** Craft a card from hand when your faction permits. Its **bottom-left crafting icons** set the cost; the card's own suit does not pay or define that cost.
new: **Craft (4.1):** **Every crafting piece gets its suit from the clearing containing it.** The card's **bottom-left crafting icons** require pieces of those clearing suits; the card's own suit does not define the cost. Craft a card from hand when your faction permits.

**Personal duplicate check:** Only an identical persistent effect **in your own play area** prevents you from crafting that effect again. Other players' copies do not count for this duplicate restriction.

old: - Persistent effect (stone box): keep card in play area and gain its text. You cannot craft an identical persistent effect already in your play area. Its card is outside your hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.
new: - Persistent effect (stone box): keep card in your play area and gain its text, subject to the personal duplicate check above. Its card is outside your hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.
